categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes ci/test/03_test_script.sh to filter excluded subtree paths from the compilation database before running IWYU.
categories.rationale: Filters excluded subtree paths to eliminate unnecessary IWYU analysis and log noise in CI. The non-enforced IWYU CI pass analyzed 14 source files in src/ipc/libmultiprocess/ only to discard the suggestions via git restore, and contributor review notes this avoids potential IWYU tool crashes on subtree code.
